readerProblem: Confusing platform audience aggregation with genuine buyer coordination authority.

propositionLedger.statement: Attention aggregation pools data for the intermediary, not agency for the participant.
A market position requires explicit representational mandate, ratification and contestability.
Sheer audience volume without exit rights or bargaining floors yields zero countervailing market power.

claimBoundary: Conceptual analysis only. Does not analyze live platform user metrics.
handoff: Prepares the volume without representation analysis for Module 03.
